confidence.basis: The review package gives an exact parent-relative source derivation, a pinned Java 8 image, generated semantic and boundary gates, canonical receipt verification, and an authoritative successful parent recovery record. Independent lightweight checks confirmed the embedded image digest and the statement-for-statement helper move.
limitations: Per task constraints, the build and generated EVM gate were not rerun; machine-parent-recovery.json was treated as authoritative.
No original artifact, network resource, or other worktree was inspected.
Acceptance is only for the bounded StringBuilder profile, not general Java StringBuilder compatibility or Minecraft completion.

findings.title: The large StringBuilder quota case is an atomic checkpoint refusal, not a StringBuilder-specific catchable-OOM proof
findings.assessment: This is honest and acceptable for the parent-amended scope. The two live 65536-char arrays make the fixed 1 MiB checkpoint unpublishable, so the gate requires LC0StateError(1,0) with an unchanged root rather than claiming a terminal caught OOM. A separate retained small field-arena fixture continues to establish catchable guest OOM behavior. The large fixture must not later be cited as a successful StringBuilder OOM/catch execution.

findings.title: append(null) intentionally differs from full Java 8 StringBuilder
findings.assessment: The bounded contract explicitly maps null to a catchable guest NullPointerException before destination allocation, rather than appending the literal string 'null'. The implementation evaluation order and dedicated fixture match that declared bound, so this is a scope constraint rather than a correctness defect.

acceptance_rationale.assessment: The pinned source constructs an empty owned char array, appends into a fresh exact-length array while preserving old/input order, returns the receiver, and creates each String result through guest String(char[]). The positive fixture checks empty/content identity, chained receiver identity, non-interned results, result independence, and preservation after later append.

The root grows from 84 to 85 and folds the new image at h[84]; the Program allocation grows by exactly one; replacement is reserved. The reverse verifier requires exactly 84 parent images byte-identical plus only StringBuilder, and the authoritative record reports prior84Exact and runtime-derived commitments.

The deleted post-VFS tail and the new internal pure helper preserve the classSlot calculation, conditional Runnable insertion, all prior class assignments, classClass, and loaderClass in the same order; StringBuilder is the sole final-slot addition at classSlot+45. Program memory and its classes array are reference types for an internal call, so these mutations remain in the caller's memory graph; no external call or state boundary is introduced. The exact reverse verifier reconstructs the helper from the parent tail and compares the entire resulting engine source. Independent package-only analysis also matched all 39 pre-existing executable tail statements in order.

The build enforces solc 0.8.30, optimizer 200, viaIR, Cancun, metadata off, derives runtime hashes into disposable coordinator/driver copies, and enforces the 393216-byte cap. Fixed raw30/262144, 1 MiB checkpoint, 128 frames, reserve, and related bounds are asserted. Generated gates retain q1/q7/direct/reopen equivalence, raw replacement, raw30/31 three-layer behavior, byte boundaries, System.err/PrintStream, EnumSet/ACC_ENUM, queue, failed-init, uninitialized, OOM, and canonical receipt controls.
